title: 2048 Classic
description: Join matching tiles and swipe your way to the legendary 2048 tile in this iconic number puzzle.

title: Block Matrix (Tetris)
description: The ultimate classic block-stacking puzzle. Rotate tetrominos, clear lines, and reach the highest level.
controls: Arrow Keys: Move/Rotate · Space: Hard Drop

title: Arcade Snake
description: Classic arcade snake with golden apples, speed progression, and smooth retro gameplay.

title: Galaxy Defender
description: Pilot your high-tech starfighter against enemy waves and epic space armadas with dual lasers.
controls: Mouse / Touch to guide & autofire ship

title: Flappy Wing
description: Tap your wings and navigate between green pipes in this notoriously challenging reflex runner.
controls: Spacebar or Click / Tap to jump

title: Brick Breaker DX
description: Smash vibrant brick walls with bouncing kinetic spheres and angle-deflecting paddles.
controls: Mouse / Touch or Left & Right arrows

title: Pixel Dino Run
description: Endless prehistoric sprint dodging desert cacti and speeding through desert sandstorms.

title: Cyber Pong
description: High-octane electronic table tennis with smart bot AI or 2-player local battle mode.
controls: P1: W/S or Mouse · P2: Up/Down Arrows

title: Minesweeper Classic
description: Logic deduction puzzle. Deduce mine coordinates using numerical adjacency and flag traps safely.
controls: Left click reveal · Right click (or flag mode) flag

title: Crossy Hopper
description: Hop through busy highways dodging speeding sports cars, trucks, and vans.
controls: Arrow keys / WASD / Tap buttons to hop
